about: List prices per million tokens, in US dollars, for the models whose turns Vyre prices itself (an API key whose provider does not send its own price). A turn keeps the price it was charged at, so a later change here never rewrites an old turn. A price that is not listed is not guessed: the turn says its cost was not reported. Cache writes are left out until the provider publishes an exact rate for them.
source: Anthropic's model table (Claude API, first-party rates)
